description: This file defines a PHP trait named ControllerTrait within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides methods for forwarding requests to other controllers, retrieving the current HTTP request, and redirecting to a specified URL, facilitating controller functionalities in a web application context.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Forwards the current HTTP request to another controller specified by name, with optional attributes and query parameters. Returns a Symfony Response object.

methods.name: getCurrentRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the current HTTP request from the RequestStack service. Returns a Request object or null.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Creates a redirect response to the specified path, preserving the scheme and host from the current request.
